quickstart.md.title: Repository Quickstart
quickstart.md.purpose: Orient a new contributor: purpose, stack, entrypoints, setup, and the shortest path to productive work.
quickstart.md.summary: Quickstart for the Electric Mind Super Day Challenge monorepo: pick one track (frontend, backend, mobile), read its START-HERE and REQUIREMENTS, run the matching mock via npm scripts (node >=24), and build your solution in that track's solution/ folder. Includes entrypoints, setup commands, and where to look next.

architecture/overview.md.title: Architecture Overview
architecture/overview.md.purpose: Explain system boundaries, major components, runtime flow, data flow, and important architectural decisions.
architecture/overview.md.summary: The repository is a multi-track challenge scaffold rather than a single application: `frontend/`, `backend/`, and `mobile/` each hold their own START-HERE/REQUIREMENTS docs plus a Node mock service, `_probe_flutter/` is a Flutter probe environment, and `support/` holds shared Node tests run via the root `npm test`. The root `package.json` is the only shared runtime contract, exposing one script per mock service.

development/workflows.md.title: Development Workflows
development/workflows.md.purpose: Document build, test, release, CI, debugging, and safe change workflows.
development/workflows.md.summary: Development workflows for this repo center on Node.js >=24 ESM mock services and a single node:test suite. Commands are defined in package.json: frontend/backend/mobile mock servers plus `npm test`, which runs support/*.test.mjs and boots the portfolio and CRM services on ephemeral ports.

symbolSummaries.name: package.json
symbolSummaries.summary: Defines the private ESM package, the Node >=24 engine requirement, and the only scripts: frontend/backend/mobile mock servers plus `node --test support/*.test.mjs`.

symbolSummaries.name: support/mocks.test.mjs
symbolSummaries.summary: The sole test suite; boots the portfolio API and CRM service on ephemeral ports, asserts data consistency, HTTP edge cases, and CRM failure modes.

symbolSummaries.name: support/portfolio-api.mjs
symbolSummaries.summary: Exports startPortfolioApi, the UI-facing mock service under test that serves accounts, portfolios, holdings detail, exchange-rate, and notification endpoints.

symbolSummaries.name: support/portfolio-data.mjs
symbolSummaries.summary: Exports scenarios, the list of dataset names the first test iterates to validate per-scenario consistency.

symbolSummaries.name: backend/crm-service.mjs
symbolSummaries.summary: Exports startCrm, the legacy CRM mock service with mode switching, injected every-fifth-request failure, and stats reporting.

symbolSummaries.name: backend/fixtures/seed.json
symbolSummaries.summary: Seed portfolios and holdings that the CRM test cross-checks: per-portfolio values must equal the sum of quantity * price.

symbolSummaries.name: startPortfolioApi
symbolSummaries.summary: Factory used by tests to start the portfolio mock with options such as port 0 and a name.

symbolSummaries.name: startCrm
symbolSummaries.summary: Factory used by tests to start the CRM mock service on an ephemeral port.

symbolSummaries.name: scenarios
symbolSummaries.summary: Named dataset variants (empty, large, gaps, all-gainers, tiny-allocation, and others) that drive both test coverage and mock responses.

symbolSummaries.name: service
symbolSummaries.summary: Test helper that starts a service on port 0, waits for listening, registers t.after cleanup with closeAllConnections, and returns fetch/get wrappers.

symbolSummaries.name: closeTo
symbolSummaries.summary: Assertion helper allowing a 0.02 tolerance for floating-point comparisons of totals, holdings, and allocations.

symbolSummaries.name: client_record
symbolSummaries.summary: CRM response envelope holding accounts; its shape changes with mode, moving accounts under relationships when nested.

symbolSummaries.name: curr_val.amt
symbolSummaries.summary: Per-account current value field in CRM responses; computed as sum of quantity * price and set to null in mode=missing.

symbolSummaries.name: acct_nickname
symbolSummaries.summary: Optional account label in CRM responses that must be absent when mode=missing is used.

symbolSummaries.name: acct_ref
symbolSummaries.summary: Account reference key in CRM responses used to match a portfolioId to its account record in tests.

symbolSummaries.name: control
symbolSummaries.summary: Helper in the CRM test that POSTs a mode to /__control to force ok, error, or timeout behavior.

symbolSummaries.name: stats
symbolSummaries.summary: Result of /__stats exposing calls, callsByPortfolio, and the active mode for CRM debugging assertions.

symbolSummaries.name: performanceHistory
symbolSummaries.summary: Time series in portfolio responses; tests require strictly increasing dates and a final point dated today matching the account total.

symbolSummaries.name: allocation
symbolSummaries.summary: Asset-class breakdown in portfolio responses whose values must sum to the portfolio totalMarketValue.

modules/mobile.md.title: Mobile Module
modules/mobile.md.purpose: Explain the responsibilities, public surface, internal flow, dependencies, and change guidance for mobile/.
modules/mobile.md.summary: Mobile Module covers the Flutter portfolio dashboard: the `mobile/solution` app (Material 3 shell, portfolio screen, SQLite cache, offline reconciliation) plus the mock API entrypoint and shared API contract. Tasks 5-10 (auth, notifications, share, account selector, holding detail, charts) are still unfinished, and `_probe_flutter` mirrors this module's setup.

symbolSummaries.summary: Thin entrypoint that imports startPortfolioApi and support/http.mjs options and launches the mock API on port 4001.

symbolSummaries.name: startPortfolioApi
symbolSummaries.summary: Factory from support/portfolio-api.mjs that the mobile mock server invokes to serve the contract-documented JSON routes.

symbolSummaries.name: Portfolio

symbolSummaries.name: Holding

symbolSummaries.name: ConnectivityService

symbolSummaries.name: portfolio_cache

symbolSummaries.name: mobile/solution/lib/screens/portfolio_overview_screen.dart

modules/probe-flutter.md.title: Probe Flutter Module
modules/probe-flutter.md.purpose: Explain the responsibilities, public surface, internal flow, dependencies, and change guidance for _probe_flutter/.
modules/probe-flutter.md.summary: The `_probe_flutter/` module is a stock Flutter `probe_app` project scaffold (package `probe_app`, application ID `com.electricmind.probe_app`). It contains only Dart/build configuration and Android platform host files — no Dart business logic, iOS, or other platform folders are present in the evidence. This page documents its surface, Android embedder flow, and change guidance.

modules/backend.md.title: Backend Module
modules/backend.md.purpose: Explain the responsibilities, public surface, internal flow, dependencies, and change guidance for backend/.
modules/backend.md.summary: The backend/ module is a from-scratch wealth-management portfolio dashboard exercise that lives in backend/solution/ and depends on a supplied mock CRM and fixtures. This page maps the supplied files (START-HERE, REQUIREMENTS, CRM, mock-crm.mjs, crm-service.mjs, seed.json, generate-history.mjs), the ten tasks, and the CRM mapping/caching/ledger flows.

symbolSummaries.name: startCrm
symbolSummaries.summary: Factory exported by crm-service.mjs that returns the mock CRM HTTP handler; it tracks mode, call count, and per-portfolio call counts and simulates the auto failure pattern.

symbolSummaries.name: metadata
symbolSummaries.summary: CRM fixture values in crm-service.mjs mapping P-9001/2/EMPTY/SINGLE to {amt, change, pct, inception}; explicitly labeled fixture data, not candidate valuation code.

symbolSummaries.name: modes
symbolSummaries.summary: The allowed CRM modes array ['auto','ok','error','timeout','missing','nested'] validated by POST /__control and per-request ?mode=.

symbolSummaries.name: behavior
symbolSummaries.summary: Computed per CRM call: 'auto' selects timeout on multiples of 10, error on multiples of 5, else ok; explicit modes pass through.

symbolSummaries.name: accounts
symbolSummaries.summary: The CRM returns every account for the client; callers must select the requested one by acct_ref rather than taking the first entry.

symbolSummaries.name: CADtoUSD
symbolSummaries.summary: Seed rate (0.73) used for the Task 7 display-currency conversion between CAD and USD.

symbolSummaries.name: ledgerCases
symbolSummaries.summary: Seed section providing oversell and outOfOrder transaction fixtures for Task 10 ledger replay edge cases.

symbolSummaries.name: currentQuantity
symbolSummaries.summary: Task 10 replay output: net shares after applying all BUY/SELL transactions chronologically.

symbolSummaries.name: averageCostBasisPerShare
symbolSummaries.summary: Task 10 replay output: weighted average cost of currently held shares under standard average-cost accounting; SELLs do not change it.

symbolSummaries.name: stale
symbolSummaries.summary: Task 9 addition to GET /portfolios/:id: true when a cached value is served past TTL because the CRM failed.

symbolSummaries.name: cachedAt
symbolSummaries.summary: Task 9 addition recording the ISO datetime when the cached portfolio value was originally fetched from the CRM.

modules/support.md.title: Support Module
modules/support.md.purpose: Explain the responsibilities, public surface, internal flow, dependencies, and change guidance for support/.
modules/support.md.summary: The support/ module holds the fictional mock services and datasets shared by the frontend and mobile tracks: a portfolio HTTP API, a legacy CRM fixture server, shared HTTP helpers, setup/maintenance docs, and a node:test suite that validates dataset consistency, edge scenarios, HTTP errors, and CRM fault controls.

symbolSummaries.name: startPortfolioApi
symbolSummaries.summary: Creates the shared portfolio HTTP API server, handling GET routes, scenario/delay validation, simulated failures, and 404/405 responses.

symbolSummaries.name: scenarios
symbolSummaries.summary: Exported array of accepted ?scenario= names in support/portfolio-data.mjs; portfolio-api.mjs rejects any value not in this list.

symbolSummaries.name: portfolioData
symbolSummaries.summary: Builds a portfolio response (summary, holdings, allocation, history) for an ID and scenario, applying dataset variants and derived totals.

symbolSummaries.name: holdingDetail
symbolSummaries.summary: Returns per-ticker detail such as purchase date, dividend yield, 52-week range, and price history, or null when the ticker is absent.

symbolSummaries.name: history
symbolSummaries.summary: Generates date/marketValue points ending on the current UTC date, with point counts and gaps driven by the scenario.

symbolSummaries.name: json
symbolSummaries.summary: Writes a JSON response with the correct content type, guarding against already-ended or destroyed responses.

symbolSummaries.name: serve
symbolSummaries.summary: Creates the Node HTTP server: sets CORS/no-store headers, answers OPTIONS and /health, wraps the handler, and normalizes errors to { error, message }.

symbolSummaries.name: options
symbolSummaries.summary: Parses --port and --host CLI flags, rejects unknown options, and validates that the port is an integer from 1 to 65535.

symbolSummaries.name: badRequest
symbolSummaries.summary: Creates an Error tagged with status 400 so serve maps it to a bad_request JSON response.

symbolSummaries.name: readJson
symbolSummaries.summary: Reads and parses a request body, capping it at 4096 bytes and throwing a 400 for oversized or malformed JSON.

symbolSummaries.name: delay
symbolSummaries.summary: Awaits the given milliseconds but resolves early if the response closes, making simulated loading delays abort-safe.

symbolSummaries.name: startCrm
symbolSummaries.summary: Starts the legacy CRM fixture server from backend/crm-service.mjs; support/mocks.test.mjs uses it to verify fixtures, controls, and timeouts.

symbolSummaries.name: templates
symbolSummaries.summary: Internal base rows (AAPL, BND, CASH, ALT, TSLA) that portfolioData copies and mutates to construct per-scenario holdings.

symbolSummaries.name: round
symbolSummaries.summary: Small helper that rounds monetary and percentage values to two decimals for consistent fixture output.

modules/frontend.md.title: Frontend Module
modules/frontend.md.purpose: Explain the responsibilities, public surface, internal flow, dependencies, and change guidance for frontend/.

Implementation lives in frontend/solution/, which is not present in the evidence.

symbolSummaries.name: frontend/START-HERE.md
symbolSummaries.summary: Setup instructions for the exercise: install Node, run the mock server, verify /health and /portfolios/P-9001, and build the app in frontend/solution/.
